description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Orleans silo components, specifically for integrating Azure Storage streaming and lease providers. It defines methods to add Azure Queue streams, configure Azure Blob lease providers, and set up related services within the Orleans hosting framework.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring Azure storage streaming and lease providers in Orleans silos.

methods.name: AddAzureQueueStreams
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use Azure Queue persistent streams with a specified name and configuration delegate.

methods.name: AddAzureQueueStreams
methods.description: Overload that configures Azure Queue streams with default settings using provided options.

methods.name: UseAzureBlobLeaseProvider
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use Azure Blob lease provider with specified options.

methods.name: ConfigureAzureBlobLeaseProviderServices
methods.description: Internal method to set up services for Azure Blob lease provider, including validators and options.

methods.name: UseAzureBlobLeaseProvider
methods.description: Configures a stream configurator to use Azure Blob lease provider with specified options.
